hookText: POV: You caught the inn's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: My diary, my dear, in this very room where whispers should softly float. I was scrubbing the hearth, my fair hands clinging to the rough stone. Suddenly, a shadow appeared, and I heard the rustle of lace and silk. He was kissing my neighbor, and I was left to wonder what secrets he shared. Was it love, or mere fleeting passion? I long to know the truth. 💕 #18thCentury #PeriodDrama #HistoricalRomance #BettyRyal #MaidLife #POV
caption:
As a young maid, I have secrets too deep to share. Would you have helped me lace my corset, or let it fall? Discover more in my Fanvue link in bio. 💍
